title: A Silence for the Inventory
author: Paloma Joubert
blurb: Beatrix Brightwater, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
